title.narrative: IFES Bangladesh Election Support (BES) program 2025-2026 - Election support in Bangladesh IFES

description.narrative: Stöd till Bangladesh valprocess genom tekniskt stöd till den nationella valmyndigheten; kapacitetshöjande insatser till civilsamhällsorganisationer för arbete med medborgarutbildning för ett ökat valdeltagande med fokus på marginaliserade grupper; samt ledarskapsutbildningar för ökat politiskt deltagande hos kvinnor.

Support to the Bangladesh electoral process with institutional strengthening to the Election Commission, capacity building of civil society organisations to deliver effective civic and voter education that fosters voter turnout, including from historically marginalized groups; as well as interventions to promote and increase political leadership and participation of women.

"Strenghthening Bangladesh´s Democratic Framework and Institutions: Bangladesh Elections Support (BES) program", has been developed by IFES based on key findings from a series of capacity assessments of the Bangladesh Election Commission, context analysis and assessments of the political landscape in which elections are to be held.
The program is comprised by three objectives/key areas of intervention:
1) Establishing the BEC as a more independent and accountable institution equipped with the capacity to deliver elections with integrity for all people.
2) Enhancing the capacity of civil society organizations, with special attention to those from historically marginalized groups, to deliver effective civic and voter education that fosters voter turnout and a lasting commitment to democratic culture and rights.
3) Equipping women, particularly rural women, women with disability, and ethnic- and religious minority women, with the skills to take on leadership roles and participate actively in the political process.
